<function name="SetShadowSlopeScaleDepthBias" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the shadow depth slope scale bias of the projected texture.

The initial value is `2`. Normal projected textures obey the value of the `mat_slopescaledepthbias_shadowmap` <page>ConVar</page>.

<validate>You must call <page>ProjectedTexture:Update</page> after using this function for it to take effect.</validate>
	</description>
	<added>2021.03.31</added>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bias" type="number">The shadow depth slope scale bias to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
